worldcombat.skill.triattack.summary: Fire, frost and spark leave the hand as three rays that fly one after another, each its own way: every ray that lands rolls its own element's mark - electric paralyses, fire burns, ice freezes. Focused form sends all three at one target; wide form sends them after up to three separate enemies.
worldcombat.skill.triattack.use.0: Put three rays into one target and roll three element marks
worldcombat.skill.triattack.use.1: Split the rays across several enemies in a crowd
worldcombat.skill.triattack.use.2: Open with a three-colour volley to wear a group down
Each of the three rays deals about %1$s power (they launch together); a ray that lands has about a %2$s chance to leave the matching element mark (electric paralyses, fire burns, ice freezes) for about %3$s. The target's Sp. Def, type matchup and criticals settle at impact.
The rays lock onto targets within %1$s blocks and fly at %2$s blocks per tick, steering %3$s degrees per tick onto the target; that only corrects movement, so a hard sideways dash still escapes.
The rays leave %1$s apart (never inside the hit invulnerability window, so each settles separately); wind-up %2$s, cooldown %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.triattack.wide.on: Wide form: the three rays split among up to three different enemies within %1$s blocks of the primary, for much wider coverage - each ray is x0.85, marks are x0.85, wind-up +1 tick and cooldown x1.15.
worldcombat.skill.triattack.wide.off: Focused form (default): all three rays lock the same target, x1.04 per ray and x1.1 mark chance, and it comes out sooner with a shorter cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.triattack.timing: Range %1$s, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.triattack.growth.0: From level %1$s each ray's power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.triattack.growth.1: From level %1$s each ray's power rises to %2$s and the mark chance to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.triattack.preference.w: On: the three rays split among up to three different enemies near the primary, for wide coverage, but each ray is x0.85, marks are x0.85, wind-up +1 tick and cooldown x1.15. Off: focused form, all three rays on one target at x1.04 per ray and x1.1 mark chance.
worldcombat.skill.triattack.preference.a: Beyond this distance the companion closes in instead of firing the volley; larger values open from further away.
When on, a target with neighbours gets priority so wide form can carry rays across; when off, it ranks as an ordinary ranged attack.
When on, targets not yet carrying burn, freeze or paralysis rank a little higher, so marks are not wasted on someone already afflicted; when off, all threats rank the same.
